assessment.summary: Beta.117 reviewed all eight official public repository/default-branch/release/tag records on 2026-11-11. Aquarea v2.0.1 migrates pump status from sensor to binary_sensor and direction to a lowercase enum; SolarPilot now accepts either exact registered role while duplicate migration states fail closed. New lifetime/today energy is not relabelled as an old period source. SDK v1.6.0 changes consumption report retry/error handling only; inspected task/status/LIVE semantics are unchanged. No provider install, binding or new actuator right. See docs/UPSTREAM_BETA117.md.
